notes.title: Minor Content Update!
notes.notes:
Hello, folks Kody here bringing you another content update and bug fix update! We have heard your feedback and have fixed a few systems that you guys had some trouble with!

Feature Updates/Change Log


 New saving and loading system that runs automatically every 2 minutes, and loads when you start the game!
 
 Fixed enemy AIs perception so it is more aware of the player and its environment it will still need tweaking so please keep the feedback coming on the AI!
 
 Fixed the grip of the car and turning so it has more weight to it and is less slippy as some described driving as if it was on ice! hopefully, this update will fix that but again please keep the feedback coming for tweaking!
 
 Fixed some level design problems in the world to make it easier to transverse.


Future Update

We are working on adding in the next 3 main missions for early access the tutorial was added in the last update and serves as the first mission but players will see new missions and side quests coming into the game in the next few days.

Thank you all for the support and we are so excited to add in our newest updates!

notes.title: Bug Fix and content addition
notes.notes: Hey, folks Kody here we added in an opening tutorial for players and fixed a few bugs! can not wait to hear what you think!
